resolution.note: override accepts a prepass-only FAIL on the exact head

title: Let the lead override a prepass-only review FAIL
body: Outcome: the lead can turn a prepass-only review FAIL into a lead decision without a wasted review attempt. Evidence: PR #175 (t-55m05ab) attempt 4 was prepass-only (records/4.json, panelVerdict null); `krn review --override` exited 70 "override requires a recorded FAIL verdict", and `--prior-record` refused a same-head record (exit 64) and a second-round record (exit 64), so attempt 5 on a new head was spent only to obtain a panel verdict. Acceptance: either `krn review --override` accepts a prepass-only FAIL on the exact head, or krn-lead step 7 states that an override needs a recorded panel FAIL and that the next attempt after a prepass-only FAIL must use `--prior-record` on a new head; a rule or CLI test covers the chosen behaviour.
